info.title: Web Security Scanner API

requests.description: Deletes an existing ScanConfig and its child resources.
requests.name: DELETE /v1beta/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{WEB_SECURITY_SCANNER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /v1beta/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{WEB_SECURITY_SCANNER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates a ScanConfig. This method support partial update of a ScanConfig.
requests.name: PATCH /v1beta/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{WEB_SECURITY_SCANNER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Start a ScanRun according to the given ScanConfig.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{name}:start
requests.note: Replace {{WEB_SECURITY_SCANNER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Stops a ScanRun. The stopped ScanRun is returned.
requests.name: POST /v1beta/{name}:stop
requests.note: Replace {{WEB_SECURITY_SCANNER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
